gigapan.description:
This is a small wasp or bee like creature that died on my windowsill, although I think it may be a fly in disguise.

This is hardly a gigapixel image but was composed of many images due to the deep focus stacking. 50 stacks deep comprising a total of 1000 images.

This was captured on a modified makerbot.
